name: MVU-Eval
abstract: MVU-Eval evaluates multi-video understanding, requiring comparison, retrieval, and reasoning across multiple videos. This page uses the Overall score from the main table.
method: This work argues that existing video benchmarks mostly assume single-video input, while real tasks often require joint analysis over multiple videos.
MVU-Eval covers both perception and reasoning, including object recognition, spatial understanding, knowledge-intensive reasoning, and retrieval-augmented tasks.
The results show that multi-video settings significantly separate model capabilities, highlighting the need for stronger cross-instance integration.
